# One command per line, run in order by .github/workflows/expo-upgrade.yml
# Batch 7: react-three-fiber for React 19.3. 9.1.2's react-reconciler 0.31 only
# matches React 19.0; 19.2 changed the reconciler internals (R3F 9.5) and 19.3
# needs R3F 9.8.2+. With the old pair, any <Canvas> crashes on render.
npm view @react-three/fiber@^9.8.2 version peerDependencies
npm install @react-three/fiber@^9.8.2
npm ls react react-reconciler @react-three/fiber
